title: SignalScoringOutput
description: One intent-signals judgement on one job post. Shape only: whether the score, recency band and tier follow the skill's rules is checked by the gate, not enforced here.

signal.description: true if the post is a buying signal for the offer described in the prompt.

signal_type.description: Kind of signal; not_signal exactly when signal is false.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes copied from the post text that support the judgement. Empty when signal is false.

factors.description: The five Signal Strength Matrix factors, each rated 1-5.

total.description: Signal Score out of 50 from the skill's Scoring Formula.

recency_band.description: Recency column of the Signal Strength Matrix for the post date vs the collection date; None if older than the Low band.

tier.description: Priority from the skill's score table.

action.description: The action the skill's score table gives for that priority.
